/*selectCommonNoNeBuyerChoiceMultiPopList*/ SELECT NVL(B.COMORG_NAME, A.COM_NAME_LOC) COMORG_NAME , A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE , A.COM_CODE , A.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY A , BYCAORGL B WHERE 1=1 AND A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE = B.COMORG_CODE(+) AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.BUSINESS_COND = 'B'
AND A.COM_CODE IN (-- 내가 담당인 고객사 SELECT DISTINCT A.BUYER FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG A , ICOMCOD2 B WHERE B.COMPANY_CODE ='KRKORE0001' AND B.TYPE ='C001' AND B.CODE = A.KEP_DEPT AND A.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE ,'YYYY') AND A.STATUS ='C' AND A.KEP_DEPT = #{st_dept} AND A.KEP_USER_ID = #{st_user_id} )
AND A.COM_CODE IN ( SELECT COM_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE BUSINESS_COND IN ('B','M') AND STATUS IN ('R','C') AND COM_CODE IN (SELECT CMPY.COM_CODE FROM ICOMCOD3 COD3 WHERE COD3.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD3.TYPE = 'CMPY' AND COD3.CODE1= 'ALL' AND COD3.CODE2 = #{st_user_id} UNION ALL SELECT MNG.BUYER FROM ICOMCOD3 COD3, MIS_BUYER_MNG MNG WHERE COD3.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD3.TYPE = 'CMPY' AND COD3.CODE1= MNG.KEP_DEPT AND COD3.CODE2 = #{st_user_id} AND MNG.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND MNG.STATUS = 'C' UNION ALL SELECT BUYER FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND STATUS = 'C' AND KEP_USER_ID = #{st_user_id} UNION ALL SELECT COD.CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 COD , ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE COD.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD.TYPE = 'CMPY' AND COD.CODE1 = CMPY.COM_CODE AND COD.CODE2 = #{st_user_id} AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN TEXT2 AND TEXT3 ) )
AND A.COM_CODE IN (-- 나의 관리 고객사 SELECT BUYER FROM BUYEROWN WHERE USER_ID = #{st_user_id} )
AND NVL(B.COMORG_NAME, A.COM_NAME_LOC) LIKE '%'||#{st_comorg_name}||'%'
AND A.COM_NAME_LOC LIKE '%'||#{st_com_name_loc}||'%'
ORDER BY A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE, COMORG_NAME
